title: Randomized value at sign means
statement: Let $P$ be a Boolean predicate on $m$ signs and fix a sign vector $x\in\{\pm1\}^m$. The randomized value of $P$ when each input mean is the corresponding coordinate of $x$ equals $1$ if $P$ accepts $x$ and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean predicate on a finite number $m$ of signs
A fixed sign vector of length $m
